name: Cow (Holstein)
headline: heightAtWithers
subtitle: Mature Holstein dairy cow
description: The black-and-white Holstein is the best-known dairy breed. Oklahoma State University and Michigan State University Extension both describe a mature Holstein cow as weighing about 1,500 lb and standing about 58 in tall at the shoulder. Calves weigh roughly 80 to 100 lb at birth.

measures.label: Height at shoulder
measures.note: Mature cow, height at the shoulder

facts.text: Holstein heifers can be bred at about 15 months old, when they weigh about 800 lb.
Oklahoma State University says a healthy Holstein calf weighs 90 lb or more at birth.
Holstein gestation lasts about nine months, and first calving is ideally between 24 and 27 months of age.

sources.publisher: Oklahoma State University, Department of Animal and Food Sciences
sources.title: Holstein Cattle (Breeds of Livestock)

sources.title: The Holstein Dairy Cow

caveats: Holstein Association USA pages (Holstein 101 and its fact sheet PDF) sat behind a bot check and could not be read.
Both sources give a single typical height and weight, not a range; bulls are not covered.
The two sources differ slightly on calf birth weight: 80 to 100 lb (MSU Extension) versus 90 lb or more (Oklahoma State).
